scope: Corrected future proposal only; does not replace historical delivered contract, Q records or verdicts. Ready remains the proposed representative sample; no generation or new acceptance assigned.

contract.intent: One static 16x16 Ready candidate for later assets/ready-confirmed.png. Required asymmetrical-arm check mark conveys success. Transparent background, full alpha permitted, no fixed palette. Cool blue accent relationship; Ready as representative sample is a specialist proposal, not approved style.

criteria.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
criteria.basis: Owner brief: 16x16 logical status cells and Ready is static. Consumer: succeeded maps to frames 1 and display.cell is [16,16].

criteria.check: The image has transparent negative space outside the designed subject and no unintended opaque canvas matte. Deliberate opaque badge, plate, outline or backing shapes may be part of the subject; authored partial-alpha subject edges or effects are permitted. Judge whether the transparent-background intent is preserved visually, without a binary-alpha or outline-free-glyph rule.
criteria.basis: Owner brief requires transparent backgrounds; it does not restrict alpha to binary values.

criteria.check: Viewed alone, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms and communicates successful completion. Do not require a specific arm ratio, stroke width, fill dominance, outline or backing recipe. Cross-asset distinctions against Working, Retry and Paused are required later when those assets exist; this sample check does not require those dependent assets.
criteria.basis: BRIEF.md line 9 expressly requires a check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion; stateAfter ok -> succeeded and statusVisuals.succeeded supplies Ready. No mandatory arm ratio, stroke width, backing shape, palette count or highlight recipe is imposed.
criteria.scope: This Ready candidate on its own; existing Start remains an accent observation, not an additional motif rejection rule.

criteria.check: Composited on #172336, the successful-completion check and its asymmetrical arms remain recognizable at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale. Decorative details may be subtle or disappear if the required semantic silhouette remains readable.
criteria.basis: Owner brief requires readable silhouettes inspected at 1x and 3x nearest on the actual dark panel; #172336 is the consumer-observed panel colour (display.background).
criteria.scope: This Ready candidate at the declared display conditions.

criteria.check: The image visibly uses the existing UI cool blue accent coherently and perceptibly. The Start fill #70b9ed is a color cue, not an exact palette requirement. The accent need not dominate the subject or occupy a fixed area; a neutral subject with a clear cool-blue accent remains eligible.
criteria.basis: Owner brief: use the existing UI's cool blue accent, no fixed palette required. #70b9ed is a consumer observation from the Start SVG fill, not an approved palette.
criteria.scope: This Ready candidate compared with the existing Start vector.

criteria.check: As a representative sample, the image has deliberate pixel-art construction and a plausible reusable treatment for the status family. Assess cluster placement, edges and contrast for the intended 1x/3x display; reject accidental noise or resampling blur that harms the intended treatment. Intentional detached details, authored antialiasing, shading, glows and irregular contours are eligible. Passing this sample-quality check does not approve the family style.
criteria.basis: Specialist expert judgment applying the brief's 'coherent pixel-art status assets' and representative-sample instruction.
criteria.scope: This Ready sample, assessed for style review; passing does not approve the family style.
